financial_anchor.caveat: H1 2026 operating income was $1.827bn; working capital and leased systems affect cash conversion.

ai_claim.claim: My Intuitive/Case Insights uses surgical data and dashboards, but disclosed evidence is platform capability and retrospective correlation rather than causal clinical improvement.
ai_claim.limitation: No paid attach, matched outcome or cash result; no broad autonomous surgery identified.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Independent benchmark research reports continuing difficulty with spatial and temporal reasoning in surgical VLMs.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: External models and research datasets, not an Intuitive product trial.

rights_limit: Hospitals and patients retain interests in video/outcomes; public terms do not establish pooled cross-hospital training rights.
materiality_summary: 5% of FY2025 GAAP operating income is $147m/year; illustrative analytics plus service savings net to $96m/year.
g2_provisional: Insufficient/provisional: E2 platform evidence lacks controlled quality-adjusted outcome and retained-cash proof.
